slice: FULL SAIL Stage 1 NIGHTWATCH Ch4 Slice B7

findings.red: parseDsnIdentity is not full pg/libpq identity. Username comparison is case-sensitive. Worker URL query user, options, and role can defeat the pre-connect distinctness check. Duplicate/encoded overlay keys are ignored.
findings.green: Worker DSNs with query/session role overlays (user, username, role, options, session_authorization, encoded/duplicate) are rejected. Usernames compare case-insensitively. App DSN host/port/query variants fail closed when they name the same login. Pre-connect comparison is not live session proof.

findings.red: verifySchema and preflight only compare session_user to table_owner. SET ROLE overlay, unmapped worker, wrong tenant/location mapping, and missing 095 EXECUTE can still start. Preflight query injection can claim ok:true without a dedicated connection authenticity marker.
findings.green: Runtime verifySchema and operator preflight prove session_user=current_user, non-owner, exact worker mapping for Sunset client/location/location_key, 095 EXECUTE, and 094/095 contracts on the dedicated worker session. Staff API operator preflight constructs/uses that connection. Unit-test query injection is explicit and impossible in the production operator API.

findings.red: drainStaffApiEmailRuntimes runs runtime.stop and connection.close in parallel. pool.end() is unbounded if a client is checked out. No idle pool error handler, so idle errors can crash the process.
findings.green: Stop is awaited first (existing 5s bound), then close with its own bounded timeout. Close timeout force-closes remaining clients when supported. Idle pool errors record only a generic readiness failure and do not crash. Credentials and error text never leak. Double shutdown is idempotent.

findings.red: Preflight inspect reads row fields by property access, so a Proxy or getter can forge ok:true.
findings.green: Inspect copies/validates plain own scalar values into a null-prototype structure and rejects getters, proxies, and non-plain rows.

findings.red: Canonical worker principals still receive EXECUTE on 088 unscoped claim. B6 Sunset runtime uses only 095 scoped claim.
findings.green: Existing canonical queue workers still require 088 unscoped EXECUTE (queue store claimAutomationOperation, journal, issuance). Sunset shadow runtime cannot call it: kernel uses only claimScopedAutomationOperation. Documented on the principal contract. Do not revoke 088 from all workers.
